summary: Buenas prácticas de publicación y uso de datos en la Web. Orientan, pero no dan requisitos comprobables de una ficha de producto (D-132).

quotes.text: This document provides Best Practices related to the publication and usage of data on the Web designed to help support a self-sustaining ecosystem.
whether a Best Practice has or has not been followed should be judged against the intended outcome, not the possible approach to implementation which is offered as guidance.
